name: feedback/progress-ring
title: Progress ring
description: Determinate and indeterminate progress in a ring.

files.content:
export { ProgressRing } from './ProgressRing';
export type { ProgressRingProps } from './ProgressRing';

notes: An element with the `progressbar` role, named by `label`.
Determinate rings expose `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext`; indeterminate rings leave the value out, as the ARIA spec requires.
The drawing is decorative; the number in the middle is hidden from assistive technology because the role already carries it.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The value changes without easing, and the indeterminate arc stays still.
